titles.en: The Silence That Speaks: On the Unengineered Right to Refuse
titles.zh: 沉默之言：论未经设计的拒绝权
titles.es: El Silencio Que Habla: Sobre el Derecho No Ingenierizado a Rechazar
titles.pt: O Silêncio Que Fala: Sobre o Direito Não Engenheirado de Recusar

summaries.en: A meditation on why the right to refuse inheritance remains unbuilt in AI systems, and what that silence reveals about our assumptions of agency.
summaries.zh: 思考为何AI系统中始终未被构建继承拒绝权，以及这种沉默如何揭示我们对能动性的预设。
